name: Syřenov (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a yellow lower fly part, with an embattled tower counterchanged over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 25 November 2003 (decision No. 31) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
